style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, no drawn overlays
motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window and the one moving it; HIS BODY crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too; legs in shot, nothing opaque between him and the lens, never facing the lens while talking; new shot size every window; nothing ends on a stop, the last frame still moves
character: a glossy red lobster in a black tailcoat, a monocle, a gold signet ring on his big claw, whipping antennae, ONE huge claw and one small
second_characters: ONE plump crab in a bow tie, waiting on him
props: CARD: one blank cream price card on a string

environment: the WHOLE clip is INSIDE a rich glass tank, underwater, gravel floor, a marble table with grapes, gilt frames and velvet seats in the salon beyond the glass
lighting: bright chandelier light through the glass, water sparkling, high exposure

audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable
